criteria.1.1: 1.1 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3, and cart B adds 3 THEN the system completes the add without raising OutOfStock
criteria.1.2: 1.2 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3, and cart B adds 3 THEN the system reports available for MUG-01 as -1
criteria.1.3: 1.3 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3, and cart B adds 3 THEN the system records a MUG-01 line of 3 in cart B
criteria.1.4: 1.4 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3, and cart B posts qty 3 to /carts/<id>/lines THEN the system returns status 200
criteria.2.1: 2.1 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3, and cart B adds 3 THE SYSTEM SHALL raise OutOfStock
criteria.2.2: 2.2 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3, and cart B adds 3 THE SYSTEM SHALL report available for MUG-01 as 2
criteria.2.3: 2.3 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3, and cart B adds 3 THE SYSTEM SHALL record no MUG-01 line in cart B
criteria.2.4: 2.4 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3, and cart B posts qty 3 to /carts/<id>/lines THE SYSTEM SHALL return status 409
criteria.3.1: 3.1 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 2 and one cart adds 3 THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO raise OutOfStock
criteria.3.2: 3.2 WHEN a reserve asks for qty less than 1 THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO raise ValueError
criteria.3.3: 3.3 WHEN a release asks for more units than are reserved THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO report available no greater than the initial stock
criteria.3.4: 3.4 WHEN a cart holding 2 MUG-01 of stock 2 calls remove for MUG-01 THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO report available for MUG-01 as 2
criteria.3.5: 3.5 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3, and cart B adds 2 THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO complete the add without raising OutOfStock
criteria.3.6: 3.6 WHEN stock of MUG-01 is 5, cart A holds 3, and cart B adds 2 THE SYSTEM SHALL CONTINUE TO report available for MUG-01 as 0
